hypotheses.statement: solang rejects the global function 'blockhash()' at compile time (unknown function or type), while solc accepts it; this means any contract using blockhash cannot be differentially tested on pallet-contracts and must be excluded or rewritten.

evidence.note: COMPILE_ASYMMETRY: solc accepted source, solang failed with 'unknown function or type blockhash' at input.sol:9:13

hypotheses.next_probe: Minimal contract with a single function 'function f() external view returns (bytes32) { return blockhash(block.number - 1); }' compiled by both toolchains; expect solc_ok=true, solang_ok=false with the same error.

hypotheses.statement: Other block/tx env vars (block.number, block.timestamp, block.coinbase, tx.gasprice, gasleft) may still be supported by solang even though blockhash is not; support is per-builtin, not blanket rejection of env vars.

evidence.note: solang error singled out only 'blockhash', suggesting block.number etc. parse fine; needs confirmation

hypotheses.next_probe: Contract with separate view functions each returning one env var (block.number, block.timestamp, block.coinbase, tx.gasprice, gasleft) and no blockhash; check which compile under solang and compare returned values against solc/anvil.
